scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @interview/api" "npm run dev -w @interview/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @interview/contracts && npm run build -w @interview/api && npm run build -w @interview/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @interview/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @interview/database && npm run typecheck -w @interview/api && npm run typecheck -w @interview/web
scripts.verify: npm run db:generate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
